# Groww App Reviews Pulse — 2026-W42
*Window: 2026-08-10 to 2026-10-18 (10 weeks) · Play Store: 1,388 reviews (2.89★) · App Store: 139 reviews (3.38★) [Coverage: partial (W36–W42)]*

## Top Themes
1. **App Stability & Performance** — 35.8% of reviews, 46.3% are 1–2★ (Play: 491, iOS: 55). Technical glitches, freezing, crashing, and biometric login problems.
2. **Trading & F&O Execution** — 30.6% of reviews, 45.0% are 1–2★ (Play: 426, iOS: 41). Issues related to orders, stop loss execution, charts, and trading lags.
3. **Customer Support & Escalation** — 7.6% of reviews, 77.6% are 1–2★ (Play: 106, iOS: 10). Difficulty reaching human support, AI bot loops, and ticket resolution.

## What Users Said
> "Customer care guys not supporting properly don’t use this app anymore Worst experience from groww" — 1★, App Store, Sep 2026
> "Overall a Good experience, it's has improved alot now. But should add "Return Value - Total & Days change" just as it's available in Moneycontrol portfolio section alongwith %change. thanks" — 3★, Play Store, Aug 2026
> "Worst customer care service, no reply for last few of my complaints till now" — 1★, Play Store, Sep 2026

## Action Ideas
1. **Biometric Session Renewal & Keep-Alive** — Implement non-blocking biometric re-auth and background session keep-alive to eliminate crashes during app switching. (Engineering, App Stability & Performance)
2. **Stop-Loss Order Pre-Validation & Chart Sync** — Introduce order pre-validation checks and sync TradingView indicators to prevent order rejection panics during peak volume. (Product, Trading & F&O Execution)
3. **AI Chatbot Human-Handoff Fast-Track** — Introduce a 2-prompt loop detection threshold in the support bot to route users directly to human executives. (Support, Customer Support & Escalation)
